description: Revexa's funding tracker: B2B companies that announced funding rounds, as reported by European and US tech news, with amount, round, country, investors, what the company does and the source article. Returns the latest full week by default; set weeks (1 to 6, the weeks the tracker holds) to go further back. Filter by region (europe, us), by round (seed, series-a, series-b-and-later) and by country (for example Germany). Example: all European Series A rounds the tracker holds = region europe, round series-a, weeks 6. The answer states the total number of matches and how many are shown. Collected weekly from open news feeds (tech.eu, EU-Startups, TechCrunch and others).

country.description: Optional country of the company, in English, for example "Germany", "United Kingdom" or "Sweden". An unknown country returns the list of countries the tracker holds.

round.description: Optional round filter. One of: seed, series-a, series-b-and-later, any. seed includes pre-seed; series-a includes extensions such as A+ and A2; series-b-and-later is Series B and every later letter. "Series A" is read as series-a.

weeks.description: How many weeks back to include, counted from the latest full week. The tracker holds 6.

name: recent_b2b_funding_rounds
title: Revexa's funding tracker: B2B funding rounds by week
